main_aim: By the end of the lesson, students can explain what is happening in a simple airport problem, using the present continuous.
objectives: Use 8 airport chunks (boarding pass, check-in desk, gate) in context.
Describe what people are doing now: She is looking for her bag.
Ask for help politely: Can you help me, please?
Place stress on the important words in short questions.
teacher_lead_in: Lead-in (3 min): mostre uma foto de aeroporto e pergunte 'What are people doing?'. Leitura: 1º contato só para o gist, 2º para os detalhes. Pré-ensine no máximo 3 palavras.
comprehensible_input_text:
Hi Marco,

Greetings from the airport! It's chaos here. I'm standing at gate 14 and my flight is boarding, but my bag isn't with me. A man at the check-in desk is helping me now. He is looking for my luggage on his computer.

My friend Lena is waiting for me at the cafe. She's drinking a coffee and she's laughing at me! The other passengers are walking to the plane with their boarding passes. I'm not walking anywhere. I'm waiting.

Oh, wait. The man is smiling and he's carrying my bag! Everything is fine. I'm running to the gate now!

Speak soon,
Ana

word_bank.meaning: where you wait to get on the plane
the place to give your bag
paper or phone ticket for the plane

true_false.statement: Ana is walking to the plane.
A man is looking for the luggage.

teacher_shadowing_note: Protocolo: (1) ouvir sem ler, (2) marcar as palavras fortes em verde, (3) echo linha a linha, (4) shadowing em voz baixa. Este diálogo é o modelo do task da próxima página.

shadowing_dialogue.speaker: Ana
shadowing_dialogue.line: Excuse me, I'm looking for my bag.

shadowing_dialogue.speaker: Ana
shadowing_dialogue.line: It's black and it has a red label.

shadowing_dialogue.speaker: Agent
shadowing_dialogue.line: Are you waiting for a flight?

shadowing_dialogue.speaker: Ana
shadowing_dialogue.line: Yes, my plane is boarding now!

shadowing_dialogue.speaker: Agent
shadowing_dialogue.line: Don't worry. I'm checking the system.

pronunciation_focus.title: Stress in compound nouns
pronunciation_focus.rule: In airport compounds, the first part is the strongest.
pronunciation_focus.common_slip: Common slip: boarding-PASS. Say BOARDing pass.

teacher_tblt_note: Ciclo: pre-task (2 min), task (8), planning (3), report (5). Durante o task não corrija: anote erros de forma (is/are, -ing) para o language focus.

tblt_task.title: Mission: Find the lost bag
tblt_task.outcome: A short report to the airport agent that describes the bag and what is happening now.
tblt_task.role_problem: You are a passenger. Your bag is missing and your plane is boarding in 20 minutes. Work with a partner who plays the airport agent.
tblt_task.pre_task: Read the prompts and the useful language below.
tblt_task.task: Passenger: explain the problem. Agent: ask questions and take notes. Then switch roles.
tblt_task.planning: Prepare 3 sentences about what is happening at the airport right now.
tblt_task.report: Tell another pair how the problem ends.
task_prompts: Say where you are and what you are doing.
Say what the agent is doing.

language_focus.title: Present continuous
language_focus.formula: Subject + am / is / are + verb-ing. She is looking for her bag.

errors.right: She is looking for her bag.

errors.wrong: I am run to the gate.
errors.right: I am running to the gate.

teacher_reconfiguration_note: Os alunos reordenam blocos de sentido (não palavras soltas) e depois transformam frases de 'I' para 'she'. Peça que sublinhem is/are/am em verde.

reconfiguration.shuffle_instruction: Put the blocks in order to make a natural sentence.

shuffle_items.intent_hint: Say what you are doing now.
shuffle_items.answer: I'm standing at gate 14 right now.

shuffle_items.intent_hint: Say what the agent is doing.
shuffle_items.answer: The agent is looking for my luggage.

shuffle_items.intent_hint: Say that your friend is relaxing.
shuffle_items.answer: My friend Lena is drinking a coffee.

reconfiguration.transform_instruction: Rewrite each sentence about Ana. Start with She.

transform_items.answer: She is waiting for her bag.
She is standing at the gate.

transform_items.original: I'm not walking to the plane.
transform_items.answer: She is not walking to the plane.

check_items.prompt: Where is the stress in 'check-in desk'?
Write a question: ask what the agent is doing.
Write two sentences about what is happening in your classroom now.

can_do: say what is happening now with am / is / are + -ing.
ask for help at an airport.
say airport compounds with the right stress.

mfp.meaning: Present continuous descreve ações em andamento agora. Diferente do simple present, não é rotina.
mfp.form: Sujeito + am/is/are + verbo-ing. Negativo: am/is/are + not. Pergunta: inverter be e sujeito. Run → running.
mfp.pronunciation: Formas contraídas: I'm, she's. -ing fraco /ɪŋ/. Compostos: acento na 1ª parte (CHECK-in desk).

anticipated_problems.problem: Omitir o verbo be: She looking...
anticipated_problems.solution: Gesto de 'be' no quadro; correção coletiva no language focus.
Cores: sujeito azul, be verde; treinar com cartões.
Mostrar 3 exemplos e deixar os alunos deduzirem a regra.

pedagogical_rationale: O texto de Ana apresenta o present continuous em contexto de problema real. A missão força o aluno a descrever o que acontece agora, e a reconfiguração em blocos treina a ordem natural sem explicar regras.
